theorems.name: Deterministic Interpretation Theorem
theorems.statement: Every conforming implementation derives the same normative interpretation from the same canonical artifact.

theorems.name: Governance Preservation Theorem
theorems.statement: If Identity Integrity, Governance Integrity, and Historical Integrity are preserved, authoritative evolution remains reconstructable.
